title: fix(spec): page.print and the flow terminal-toast translations read live in the liveness ledger, so a print page is no longer warned that nothing applies it
body:
Fixes #23710
Clause-②: no

The console at the `.objectui-sha` pin (`f96f771140f1`) prints a page that declares `print` and shows the translated flow terminal toasts. The liveness ledger still graded both `planned`, so `lintLivenessProperties` told every author of a print page that printing it prints the screen layout. This PR flips those verdicts to `live`, citing each objectui reader at the pin, drops `print`'s `authorWarn`, and rewrites `PagePrintSchema`'s describes, which said "until it ships, nothing applies it". The accept set does not change. The `parentDataSource` leg stays with #23585.

## Evidence per flipped verdict (objectui re-read at `f96f771140f1`, the pin this lands against)

Each reader's landing commit is an ancestor of the pin: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 2312bd9a6 f96f771140f1` gives exit 0 (objectui#11958), and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 42d8e8db6 f96f771140f1` gives exit 0 (objectui#12075). Both were read in a full, non-shallow objectui clone.

**`page.json` `props.print`: 13 rows, all read, all flipped.** That is the container, its 8 keys, and the 4 `margins` sides. The card counted 12 children, because `margins` is both a key and a container. No row stays `planned`.

| Row | Reader at the pin |
|:---|:---|
| `print` (container) | `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx#PageRenderer` mounts `buildPagePrintStylesheet(print)` as a `style` element, only when `schema.print` is an object, and stamps the page root with `PRINT_PAGE_ATTRIBUTE`. The refusals stay cited as before: the spec's `checkPagePrintComposition` and lint's `validatePrintPageBlocks`. |
| `paperSize`, `orientation` | `page-print.ts#buildPagePrintStylesheet` writes `@page { size }` through `pageRule`, and only for an enum member. |
| `margins` and `margins.top` / `.right` / `.bottom` / `.left` | `pageRule` writes one `margin-SIDE: Nmm` for each declared finite, non-negative side. |
| `pageNumbers` | `pageRule` writes the `@bottom-right` margin box with `counter(page)` / `counter(pages)`. |
| `repeatHeader`, `repeatFooter` | `page.tsx#RunningRegions` puts the region in a real `thead` / `tfoot`. `runningRegionRules` turns that table back into a table on paper. |
| `repeatTableHeaders` | `thead { display: table-header-group }`, or `table-row-group` when the key is `false`. |
| `avoidBreakInside` | `break-inside: avoid` on every block of a region. |

**`translation.json` `flows.successMessage` / `flows.errorMessage`.** `packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts#translatedFlowMessage` calls the spec's `translateFlow` for `flows.FLOW.KEY` and falls back to the served string. `interpretFlowResponse` (the terminal-success arm) and `flowFailureMessage` call it. `views/FlowRunner.tsx#FlowRunner` passes the run's flow name and bundle. The spec-side evidence in each row is unchanged.

`authorWarn` / `authorHint` are dropped from `print` in the same edit, because `check:liveness` refuses them on a `live` row. With that, **no shipped ledger row opts into `authorWarn` any more**: `print` was the last one.

## Describes (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`)

Only text changed: the 8 key describes, `PageSchema.print`'s describe, the `PagePrintSchema` docblock, the `print` property's docblock, and the section comment above the printable subset. Each one now names the console's browser print rendering as the consumer that applies the key. The server-side PDF renderer (card ③) is still "to follow". No schema shape, enum, alias or refinement was touched. `check:authorable-surface` is in the gate run below.

## Pins

- `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`
  - **Reversed.** The #21127 control used `page.print` as its "warned `planned` row". A new `#23710` block pins the issue's criterion on the real ledger: a page declaring `print` gets no `liveness-planned-property`. The anti-vacuity check is that the same call still raises the `externalSharingModel` dead row.
  - **Moved to the planted ledger.** The "a warned `planned` row still warns" control now uses the planted translation group that the file already uses for exactly this shape.
  - **Re-anchored.** The hint-leak pin's anti-vacuity line asserted that at least one shipped opt-in row exists. That row was `print`. The line is removed, and its comment now says that both opt-in classes are held by the SYNTHETIC case right below it.
- `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts`: the census control asserted that the shipped walk reaches at least one warned row, which was `print`. The reach is now proved on a copy with one shipped `planned` row marked `authorWarn`: the gate stays green and the census counts exactly one more row.

## Generated

`content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`, `liveness/state-counts/page.md` (planned 11 → 0) and `liveness/state-counts/translation.md` (planned 2 → 0) were regenerated with `gen:docs` and `gen:liveness-counts`. Those are the two that `check:generated` proved stale. Nothing was hand-written in them.

## Verification (head `6375c0cb15`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 679 files, 20,756 passed, 1 todo, exit 0. Run under `os-verify-lock` on head `6375c0cb15`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 139 files, 6,767 passed, 5 skipped, exit 0. Run on `d03703eb`. The lint package has not changed since; the only later commit edits a spec script test.
- `typecheck` exit 0 for `@objectstack/lint` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`) and `@objectstack/spec` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:scripts-typecheck` + `check:test-typecheck`).
- `check:generated` on the built spec: the first run named exactly two stale artifacts (`content/docs/references/**`, `liveness/state-counts/`), both regenerated. It is in the derived run below at exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) gives 110 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, on head `6375c0cb15` after a full workspace build: **110 exit 0**. The `--ran` reconciliation over the `COMMAND :: exit N` record reports "110 derived, 110 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a DERIVED zero)". An earlier pass on `9c9f0a3e` returned 7 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` exit 3s (unbuilt `dist/` and a shallow clone). Those are not measurements; they cleared after `git fetch --unshallow` and the build.
- Local-only families: `check:dev-prereqs` exit 0, `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
- CI owns everything else (the artifact rosters, wide-population families, path-scheduled jobs and type-check lanes that `dispatch-gates` lists outside the derived total).
- No ablation: no runtime behaviour changed. What the ledger flip did change was observed directly: against the flipped ledger, the two anti-vacuity pins that counted on a shipped opt-in row went red (`lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` hint-leak pin, "expected 0 to be greater than 0"; `check-liveness.test.ts` census, "a walk reaching zero warned rows is a degraded walk"). Both were re-anchored as described above. I rewrote the `print` control before running it against the new ledger, so its red was not observed.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`: the `page` and `translation` prose cells described the old verdicts, so I updated them. These two cells are outside the claim's listed file surface, but leaving them would keep a published statement this PR makes false. `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts` is outside the listed surface for the same reason: its pin asserted the old census.
- `.changeset/pre/22158-print-page-spec.md` still says nothing applies `print`. That file is pre-mode release state, so this PR leaves it alone.
- `check-liveness.mts` has a comment recording an old count ("3 opt in with `authorWarn`"). It is a dated measurement, not a claim about the current tree, and is left as is.
- PR #23708 edits other regions of `page.zod.ts` and `liveness/page.json` and also regenerates `page.mdx`. It was not on `main` when this was pushed, so whichever lands second merges `main` and regenerates through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, keeping both changes.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch. The ledger (`files[]` includes `liveness`) and the describes ship in the package, and `@objectstack/lint` reads the ledger from it. `@objectstack/lint`'s published code is unchanged; only its tests changed.
